images.title: Dots that add columns
images.purpose: Show picture 1, 2 and 3 of the sequence 3, 6, 9 as columns of 3 dots, each picture adding one column.
images.composition: Three dot pictures in a row with wide gaps, each with a small label below.
images.exact_structure: Picture 1: 1 column of exactly 3 dots. Picture 2: 2 columns of 3 dots, 6 dots. Picture 3: 3 columns of 3 dots, 9 dots. Dots equal size and evenly spaced; the newest column in each picture in amber #E69F00, earlier columns in teal #0072B2. Exactly 3 pictures, 18 dots drawn in all.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a column with other than 3 dots
an added column of a different shape
images.takeaway: Each picture adds one more column of 3 dots.
images.description: Three dot pictures with 1, 2 and 3 columns of 3 dots, the newest column in amber.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at the amber column in each picture and say how many dots it holds.

image_decisions.why: The growing columns show the add-3 step as a shape.
